items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: No. But he was something else, that Stuff Smith. ... Yeah. They played in the hotel. ... Wasn't Stuff in that band? Stuff Smith? ... Yeah.

ctx.x: You didn't do it in those days maybe?
No. But he was something else, that Stuff Smith.
Yeah. Was he fronting that band or who was fronting that band?
